youtube.title: Why do planes fly at odd and even heights? #Shorts
youtube.description:
Why do eastbound and westbound flights use different heights? Because of a tragedy.

In 1956, two airliners collided over the Grand Canyon and 128 people died. It led to the creation of America's Federal Aviation Administration and strict rules for who flies where. Today, flights heading east take odd thousands of feet, and flights heading west take even ones, so they can never meet head on at the same height.

Full episode on the channel.
